title: The record store finishes S13: decisions.md migrated, one standards router, packets carry no decision ids
body:
Source: S13 lane report 2026-11-16 after #1119 (2a7ae79) merged with t-bp8c2f9 closed while part of its plan Outcome remained.
Outcome: decisions.md is migrated into the record store; standards CLI verbs go through one router; scripts/claude/memory-refs.ts is shortened to the store query; session and lane packets are checked to carry no decision ids.
Proof: `bin/krn decide list --json` returns the decisions formerly in decisions.md; a test fails when a packet carries a decision id.
Files: .agents/decisions.json, src/brain, src/cli/standards, scripts/claude/memory-refs.ts
